properties.displayName: Deny paid Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans
properties.description: Blocks setting any Defender for Cloud plan (Microsoft.Security/pricings) to the Standard (paid) tier, except plans listed in allowedStandardPlans. Discovery and FoundationalCspm always report Standard but are free. Prevents a repeat of the 2026-10 incident where an ALZ DINE policy re-enabled every paid plan (personal-technology docs/412, docs/417).

metadata.description: Deny blocks the change; Audit only reports it.

metadata.displayName: Plans allowed on the Standard tier
metadata.description: Plan names (pricing resource names) that may be Standard. Defaults to the two free ones.
